key.name: window-width
key.description: The last saved width of the main window, in logical pixels, used to restore window size on startup.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The last saved height of the main window, in logical pixels, used to restore window size on startup.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when last closed, used to restore window state on startup.

key.name: enabled-host-cli-execution
key.summary: Allow running CLI coding agents installed on the host
key.description: Whether Nexus is allowed to invoke CLI coding agent binaries installed on the host system via flatpak-spawn --host. This is an explicit, off-by-default opt-in: the underlying D-Bus permission (--talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak) is declared statically in the Flatpak manifest because Flatpak has no concept of an in-app toggleable D-Bus permission, but Nexus's own code never performs a host spawn unless this setting is true. See build-aux/flatpak/PERMISSIONS.md for the full explanation.

key.name: telemetry-enabled
key.description: Nexus collects no telemetry and sends no usage data anywhere. This key exists only so the Privacy preferences page has a concrete, documented switch to display as permanently off; it is not wired to any data-collection or network-reporting code, and Nexus has no mechanism that would turn it on by itself.

key.name: pricing-table-last-updated
key.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recording when the bundled provider pricing table (used for local usage-cost estimates) was last updated. Empty if never recorded.

key.name: default-chat-model-ids
key.description: Ordered list of provider/model identifiers to pre-select when opening a new multi-model chat comparison. Empty by default.
